# Review - PR 573 @ 0a3c601175f6aa2a8ff8e7417105927e014e087c

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: c3ac113ae155dd085fba2999172be5685f02740c. Five files, +205/-59 against base `main` (merge-base 7cc6575f79e719e6adde892ae8523bd82284adfd): two new Lean theorems preserving the `lem:qld-4-12` assembly and the uniform Naimark ancilla, the matching blueprint node and status flip, and the linearity paper-gap note plus its register row.

## Findings

- [x] F1 (prose; changes) docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md:26 - carried over from review 5237038395 and resolved at this head: the linearity row's blueprint-node column now lists `lem:linearity-common-ancilla`, and the status cell states the proved uniform-ancilla result (`exists_exactly_linear_observables_commonAncilla`) together with the residual, unproved zero-state-padding step, replacing the false "no common-extension theorem exists yet". The gap note's closing section (`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex:392-396`) again designates the register as the complete audit status instead of admitting staleness.
- [x] F2 (prose; changes) docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex:45-46 - carried over and resolved: the sentence now reads "This replaces the binary-linearity argument; it does not establish the source's padding assumption." A repository-wide duplicated-word scan over the three changed prose files finds no further instance.
- [x] F3 (code; minor, non-blocking) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:18 - carried over from review 5237038395 and still present: the module docstring (line 18) and the `CombinedPointsWitness.extendedQ` docstring (line 40) cite `...14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:993-1011` for `lem:qld-4-12`, while `extendedQ_spec` (line 229) and `exists_extendedQ` (line 318) cite `:993-1018` for the same lemma. In the mirror the statement ends at 1011 and the proof at 1018, so each span is individually defensible and `AGENTS.md` (Documentation) only requires a paper label or an anchored mirror line range; this is an internal inconsistency, not a rule violation, so it does not block merge. Suggested fix, when the file is next touched: use one span throughout.

## Review

Checked against the `github/main` copies (c3ac113ae155dd085fba2999172be5685f02740c) of `local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` section 5, and the Faithful Formalization Policy / Proof Integrity sections of `AGENTS.md`. Base is `main`, so the whole main-relative diff was reviewed.

Code. `exists_extendedQ` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:318`) constructs rather than assumes: it destructs `exists_combinedPointsWitness` (same file, line 67, `∃ deltaQ, IsPolyErr deltaQ ∧ ∀ P ε S, Nonempty (CombinedPointsWitness S (deltaQ ε))`) and applies `extendedQ_spec`, whose only argument is the witness. No hypothesis is added, and no bridge, residual or proof-obligation input in the sense of the faithfulness policy appears. Its four conclusions correspond one-to-one to the source lemma at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:993-1011` (projectivity of the measurement; self-consistency; the two ordered products `M^X_a M^Z_b` and `M^Z_b M^X_a` summed over `alpha*a + beta*b = c`), with the source's "Furthermore, all symmetric equivalents of these approximations also hold" carried by the `∀ p1 p2, p1.IsOpposite p2` quantifier, and a single `deltaQ` with `IsPolyErr` matching the blueprint's "where `delta_Q` is the function of Lemma 4.10". `exists_exactly_linear_observables_commonAncilla` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Linearity.lean:188`) is a genuine strengthening of `exists_exactly_linear_observables`: `ι'`, its two instances and the unit vector are bound before the quantifiers over `ι`, `δ`, `ρ` and the family; the correlation hypothesis is character-for-character the one of the existing theorem; the conclusion is the same exact linearity plus the same `≤ 2 * δ` averaged squared state-dependent operator distance. The unused `_ht : 0 < t` narrows rather than weakens the statement and matches the blueprint's "For every positive integer `t`". Reuse: `naimarkAncilla`, `norm_naimarkAncilla`, `roundedObservable`/`roundedObservable_mul`, `avg_stateDepDistSq_roundedObservable_eq_avg_multiplicativeDefect` and `avg_multiplicativeDefect_le_two_mul_error` all already exist on `github/main` (NaimarkRounding.lean, Stability.lean, BLR.lean); neither new name exists on main, so nothing is duplicated. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` in either touched file. I re-elaborated both files at the published head in the PR worktree: `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Linearity.lean` and `.../Points.lean` both rc=0 with no diagnostics. Exact-head CI is green on all nine contexts (`local-ci/build`, `blueprint-render`, `paper-gaps`, `blueprint-sync`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion`, `statement-origin`, `summary`). Files are 369 and 218 lines. Commit subjects and PR body follow the conventions.

Prose. The `\notready` to `\leanok` flip on `lem:qld-4-12` is warranted: the linked `exists_extendedQ` is proved sorry-free and matches the blueprint statement clause by clause, and its dependency `lem:qld-4-10` carries `\leanok` already; putting the two implementation declarations on the proof block follows the existing pattern (30 blueprint proofs on main carry `\lean{...}`). The new `lem:linearity-common-ancilla` is mathematically equivalent to the Lean statement (ancilla index set `F_2^t ⊔ {⊥}` versus `Option (Fin t → ZMod 2)`, quantifier order, `δ ≥ 0`, density-operator conditions, exact linearity for all pairs, `2δ` bound), is explicitly labelled a formalization-only auxiliary rather than a source statement, and every `\uses` label resolves (`def:povm-conventions`, `lem:naimark-rounding`, `lem:boolean-representation-stability`, `lem:blr-defect-identity`, and on `lem:qld-4-12` `lem:qld-4-10`, `def:expanded-state`, `def:expanded-point-measurement`, `def:povm-distance`, `def:symmetric-equivalents`, `fact:data-processing`). The `rem:linearity-import` rewrite is accurate: it no longer claims the two conversions are discharged in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`, and it separates the now-proved uniformity of the optional ancilla from the still-open absorption into zero-state padding, which the source assumes without construction at `...14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:832`. The gap note's `F_2^{2t}` index length for the fiberwise application and `F_2^{t}` for the declaration itself are both correct. F1 and F2 of the previous review are resolved; no new prose defect found.

Not checked: no bare `lake build` and no `#print axioms` run by me - I relied on the exact-head green `local-ci/build`, `proof-debt` and `proof-evasion`; the internal correctness of the untouched `exists_combinedPointsWitness` and `extendedQ_spec` proof bodies beyond their statements; the blueprint HTML rendering (green `local-ci/blueprint-render` only).

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
